content:
Height of cylindrical part: \(2\sqrt{13^2-5^2}=24\).  
Cap height at each end: \(13-12=1\).

Removed volume:
\[
\pi(5^2)(24)+2\cdot \frac{\pi(1)^2(3\cdot 13-1)}{3}
=600\pi+\frac{76\pi}{3}
=\frac{1876\pi}{3}.
\]

Original volume:
\[
\frac{4}{3}\pi(13^3)=\frac{8788\pi}{3}.
\]

Bead volume:
\[
\frac{8788\pi}{3}-\frac{1876\pi}{3}=2304\pi.
\]

New sphere radius:
\[
\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3=2304\pi \implies r^3=1728 \implies r=12.
\]

\boxed{12}
